meta.scope: Turkey Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. TurkStat institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI (elevated inflation environment), CBRT institutional core, BOP. Population ~88 million.

candidates.title: Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the Turkish statistical system.

candidates.title: Population census and estimates
candidates.description: Official population census and Address-Based Population Registration System estimates. Population is approximately 88 million; urbanisation is high and the age structure is still relatively young compared with Europe.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Turkey (GDP)
candidates.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for a large, diversified upper-middle-income economy with significant manufacturing and services.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Turkey has experienced elevated and volatile inflation in recent years; the CPI series is a critical high-frequency price and policy signal.
candidates.notes: Core high-frequency price node. Elevated-inflation environment gives this series high centrality.

candidates.title: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (CBRT) institutional and reporting core
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management, banking supervision support and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Structural current-account dynamics, strong tourism and services credits, and capital-account volatility are recurring features.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node with important services/tourism contribution.

candidates.title: Turkey foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and CBRT sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the TurkStat institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBRT institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Turkish research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node for Turkish research.
